blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language-aligned and self-supervised visual encoders offer complementary strengths in semantic abstraction and spatial detail. Harnessing this complementarity requires enriching local features while retaining distinctions between semantically related patches. We introduce PAIQ , a patch-aligned semantic injection framework that combines content-based cross-encoder matching with orthogonally constrained residual updates. Using DINOv3 patch features as the spatial base, PAIQ aggregates complementary SigLIP features through joint source allocation and injects the aggregate–base differences through a shared orthogonal transformation Q Q . This rotation adapts update directions while preserving residual norms and pairwise angles. For fixed projected features, we derive conditions for patch separability under similar semantic aggregates and show that rotation adds a nonnegative separation term over direct interpolation when the aggregate is shared. Only the projection and fusion parameters are trained; both visual encoders and the language model remain frozen, and fusion retains 196 visual tokens. Across diverse language backbones, PAIQ yields broad gains in judge-assessed correctness and reductions in hallucination severity over single-encoder interfaces on image description and visual question answering. On the 2B and 9B Qwen backbones, this compact interface outperforms the strongest evaluated fusion or token-compression baselines by about 2.9 correctness points on average.
blocks.zh: 语言与自我监督的视觉编码器在语义抽象和空间细节方面提供了互补的优势. 利用这种互补性需要丰富当地的特点,同时保留与集合相关的补丁之间的区别。 我们引入了PAIQ,一个补丁语义注入框架,它结合了基于内容的交叉编码器匹配正统限制的剩余更新. 利用DINOv3补丁特性作为空间基础,PAIQ聚合互补 SigLIP的特征通过联合源分配,并通过共享正交转换 Q Q 注入集合-基差. 这种旋转可以适应更新方向,同时保留剩余规范和对角. 对于固定的预测特征,我们得出了类似语义集合下补丁分离的条件,并表明在共享集合时,旋转会比直接插值增加一个非负分离词. 只有投影和聚变参数得到训练;视觉编码器和语言模型都保持冻结,聚变保留了196个视觉符号. 跨各种语言主干网,PAIQ在法官评估的正确性和减少幻觉严重性方面,在图像描述和视觉问题回答方面比单编码器接口产生广泛收益。 在2B和9B Quen的骨干上,这种紧凑的接口平均比最强的评价聚变或符号压缩基线高出约2.9正确点.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurate visual-language understanding requires both semantic recognition and local visual detail. Identifying an object’s category is different from resolving its attributes, parts, and spatial relations, and these judgments rely on different levels of visual representation. Image-text pretraining gives encoders such as SigLIP a strong connection between visual content and language concepts, while self-supervised training gives encoders such as DINOv3 strong local correspondence and dense representations ( SigLIP ; DINOv2 ; DINOv3 ) . Both families encode semantic and spatial information, but with different emphases. Their complementarity therefore offers a route to visual features that are both semantically expressive and locally discriminative (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 准确的视觉语言理解既需要语义识别,也需要局部视觉细节. 确定一个物体的类别不同于解决它的属性,部分和空间关系,这些判断依赖于不同层次的视觉表现. 图像文本预训使SigLIP等编码器在视觉内容和语言概念之间有很强的联系,而自我监督的训练则给DINov3等编码器提供了强烈的本地函证和密集的表示(SigLIP;DINov2;DINov3). 两个家族都对语义和空间信息进行编码,但重点不同. 因此,其互补性为视觉特征提供了一条途径,这些特征既具有表征性,又具有地方歧视性(图1)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Complementary visual representations and the PAIQ fusion principle. DINOv3 and SigLIP both encode semantic and local information, but with different representational preferences. PAIQ takes the spatial features as a base and introduces language-aligned features through content matching and residual enrichment, producing a patch-wise fused representation.
blocks.zh: 图 1:辅助视觉表现和PAIQ聚变原则. DINOv3和SigLIP都同时编码语义信息和本地信息,但具有不同的代表偏好. PAIQ将空间特征作为基础,通过内容匹配和剩余浓缩引入语言匹配特征,产生补丁式的引信化代表.

blocks.en: Existing systems combine multiple feature sources through channel fusion on a shared grid, learned queries, or cross-encoder attention while controlling the visual sequence length ( COMM ; Eagle ; BRAVE ; Cambrian1 ; CoMEVL ) . Complementary sources alone, however, do not guarantee that a fused local representation will retain both semantics and detail. Several patches on the same garment may share the concept of clothing, while still differing in cuffs, patterns, and boundaries. Grid alignment and feature aggregation do not by themselves constrain how these distinctions change after fusion. The central question is how to bring complementary semantics to each location while preserving the distinctions between locations.
blocks.zh: 现有系统在控制视觉序列长度(COMM;Eagle;BRAVE;Cambrian1;CoMEVL)的同时,通过共享网格上的通道聚变,学到的查询,或交叉编码器的注意,将多个特征源结合起来. 然而,仅靠补充来源并不能保证已合并的当地代表将保留语义和细节。 同一服装上的一些补丁可能分享服装的概念,但在袖口、图案和界限方面仍然不同。 网格对齐和特征汇总本身并不限制这些区分在聚变后的变化。 中心的问题是,如何在保留不同地点的区别的同时将互补语义带给每个地点。

blocks.en: We introduce PAIQ , which combines the strengths of the two encoders through patch-wise semantic enrichment (Figure 2 ). Its guiding principle is simple: semantic evidence may be shared, while local representations need not become identical . PAIQ takes projected DINOv3 patch features as the base and reads complementary features from SigLIP through content matching. A finite-step Sinkhorn-style sequence of row and column normalizations adjusts the readout weights jointly, so source assignment reflects both content compatibility and competition among all queries. The difference between the aggregated feature and the base feature is passed through a shared orthogonal transformation and added back at a fixed scale. Each output token is thus formed by cross-encoder correspondence followed by a constrained residual update, without appending a second visual sequence.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PAIQ,它通过补丁智能语义浓缩(图2)结合了两个编码器的优点. 其指导原则很简单:语义证据可以共享,而地方表述则不需要完全相同。 PAIQ将预测的DINOv3补丁特性作为基础,通过内容匹配从SigLIP读取互补特性. 有限步骤的Sinkhorn风格的行序和列常态会联合调整读出权重,因此源指派既反映了内容兼容性,也反映了所有查询之间的竞争. 集合特征与基特征的区别通过共享的正交转换传递,并在固定尺度上再加回. 每个输出令牌因此由交叉编码器的通信组成,然后是受限的剩余更新,而不附加第二个视觉序列.

blocks.en: The shared orthogonal transformation learns update directions while preserving residual norms and pairwise angles. For fixed projected features, when two positions receive the same aggregate, the squared distance between their fused features equals the squared distance from direct interpolation plus a non-negative rotation term. When aggregates are close, an explicit lower bound gives a sufficient condition for the outputs to remain distinguishable. Positions can therefore share semantic sources while retaining different representations through their own spatial bases. PAIQ is trained with an autoregressive answer objective; both visual encoders and the language model remain frozen, and the language model still receives 196 visual tokens.
blocks.zh: 共享的正交转换在保留剩余规范和对角的同时学习更新方向. 对于固定的预测特征,当两个位置得到相同的总和时,其引信特征之间的平方距离等于与直接插值的平方距离加上一个非负旋转术语. 当总量接近时,明确的下限就足以使产出保持可区分性。 因此,位置可以共享语义源,同时通过自己的空间基础保留不同的表达. PAIQ以自动回转的回答目标进行训练;视觉编码器和语言模型都保持冻结,语言模型仍然收到196个视觉符号.

blocks.en: Across four datasets and diverse language backbones up to 27B, PAIQ yields broad gains in judge-assessed correctness and reductions in hallucination severity over matched single-encoder interfaces. On the 2B and 9B Qwen backbones, it achieves the highest correctness scores among the evaluated multi-encoder and token-compression methods on every dataset ( CoMEVL ; MERV ; LLaVAMini ; Granulon ) . A matched Qwen3.5-2B ablation shows that learned residual rotation improves task-macro correctness by 31.81 score points over direct interpolation, highlighting the role of the update parameterization. A local residual-removal intervention further tests whether generated answers rely on the injected evidence.
blocks.zh: 在整个四个数据集和27B以下的多种语言主干网中,PAIQ在法官评估的正确性以及比对应的单一编码器接口的幻觉严重性降低方面取得了广泛的收益。 在2B和9B Quen的骨干上,它在每个数据集(CoMEVL;MERV;LLaVAMini;Granulon)上,在被评价的多编码器和符号压缩方法中实现了最高的正确性分数. 匹配的Qwen3.5-2B 放大显示,学到的剩余旋转比直接插值提高31.81分,提高了任务宏观正确性,突出了更新参数化的作用. 当地的残余清除干预进一步检验是否根据注入的证据得出答案。

blocks.en: The main contributions are: • Structured cross-encoder semantic enrichment. We introduce PAIQ, a patch-wise fusion framework that unifies content matching, joint source allocation, and orthogonal residual updates, combining spatial features with language-aligned features in a fixed-length visual sequence. • Local separability under shared semantics. We construct a direction-adaptation mechanism that preserves residual geometry, derive an exact distance decomposition under shared aggregates, and give a sufficient lower bound for retaining local distinctions during semantic enrichment. • Improvements across backbones and scale. We demonstrate broad gains in judge-assessed response quality across language backbones and scales, and examine the role of residual enrichment through a matched ablation and fixed-answer interventions.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献有: • 结构化跨编码语义浓缩. 我们引入了PAIQ,一个将内容匹配,联合源分配和正向剩余更新统一起来的补丁式聚变框架,将空间特征与语言相匹配的特征结合到固定长视序中. • 共享语义下的地方分离性。 我们构建了一种方向适应机制,能够保留残存几何,在共享聚合物下得到精确的距离分解,并给保留语义浓缩时的局部区别留下足够的较低约束. • 改进各骨干和规模。 我们显示,各语文主干网和规模在法官评估的对策质量方面取得了广泛进展,并通过相应的减量和固定回答干预,审查剩余资源丰富的作用。

blocks.en: Structured cross-encoder semantic enrichment. We introduce PAIQ, a patch-wise fusion framework that unifies content matching, joint source allocation, and orthogonal residual updates, combining spatial features with language-aligned features in a fixed-length visual sequence.
blocks.zh: 结构化跨编码语义浓缩. 我们引入了PAIQ,一个将内容匹配,联合源分配和正向剩余更新统一起来的补丁式聚变框架,将空间特征与语言相匹配的特征结合到固定长视序中.

blocks.en: Figure 2: PAIQ overview. Content matching aggregates SigLIP features for each DINOv3 patch, and a shared orthogonal transformation rotates the aggregate–base difference before adding it back. The two streams become 196 visual tokens; source allocation, update magnitude, and fixed-answer likelihood sensitivity describe how the representation is constructed and used.
blocks.zh: 图2:PAIQ概览。 内容匹配总量 每个 DINOv3 补丁的 SigLIP 特性, 共享正交转换在加回集合基差前旋转 。 这两个流成为196个视觉符号;源分配,更新的量,以及固定的答案概率灵敏度描述了表达方式的构造和使用.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Pretraining objectives shape the visual information available to multimodal large language models (MLLMs).
CLIP and SigLIP learn language-aligned features from image–text supervision ( CLIP ; SigLIP ) , whereas DINOv2 and DINOv3 learn self-supervised representations that encode local structure and support dense prediction ( DINOv2 ; DINOv3 ) .
These capabilities are not exclusive to either family: SigLIP 2 improves localization and dense features ( SigLIP2 ) , while dino.txt aligns DINOv2 features with text ( DINOText ) .
At the MLLM interface, Granulon uses a text-conditioned granularity controller to guide pooling and relation-aware clustering, constructing multi-granularity semantic tokens within a single DINOv3 stream ( Granulon ) .
Complementing single-stream adaptation, Eyes Wide Shut identifies visual blind spots in CLIP that persist in downstream MLLMs and mitigates them by incorporating self-supervised features ( EyesWideShut ) .
blocks.zh:
预训目标塑造了多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)可用的视觉信息.
CLIP和SigLIP从图像-文本监督(CLIP;SigLIP)中学习语言匹配的特征,而DINov2和DINov3则学习自我监督的表达方式,编码本地结构并支持密集预测(DINov2;DINov3).
这些能力不仅限于两个家庭: SigLIP 2改进了本地化和稠密特性(SigLIP2 ),而dino.txt则将DINOV2特性与文本(DINOText )相协调.
在MLLM接口中,Granulon使用文本条件的颗粒性控制器来引导集合和关系意识集群,在单个的DINOv3流(Granulon )内构建多腺语义符号.
作为单流适应的补充,Eyes Wide Shut在CLIP中识别了在下游MLLM中持续存在的视觉盲点,并通过纳入自我监督的特征(EyesWide Shut)来缓解这些盲点.

blocks.en:
Multi-encoder interfaces must reconcile heterogeneous token grids while controlling the sequence length presented to the language model.
Common-grid approaches align spatial layouts before fusion: COMM aggregates multilayer CLIP and DINOv2 features on a shared patch grid and fuses them along the channel dimension ( COMM ) , while Eagle resamples diverse expert features to a common grid before channel concatenation ( Eagle ) .
For video, MERV pools features onto a shared spatiotemporal grid and predicts input-dependent, encoder-level mixture weights ( MERV ) .
An alternative is to aggregate features into learned queries: BRAVE’s MEQ-Former produces a fixed-length multi-encoder representation ( BRAVE ) , while Cambrian-1 arranges queries on a two-dimensional grid and restricts each query to spatially corresponding regions across encoders ( Cambrian1 ) .
CoME-VL instead uses SigLIP 2 tokens as queries over DINOv3 keys and values to fuse heterogeneous grids, with orthogonal projections applied during multilayer aggregation within each encoder ( CoMEVL ) .
Focusing on token reduction, LLaVA-Mini combines query-based compression with image–text pre-fusion, reducing the explicit visual tokens passed to the main language model while also conveying visual information through conditioned text states ( LLaVAMini ) .
blocks.zh:
多编码器接口必须在控制向语言模型呈现的序列长度的同时,调和各种符号网格.
聚变前的空间布局: COMM在共享的补丁网格上聚合多层CLIP和DINOv2特性,并沿通道维度(COMM)将其熔化,而老鹰则在通道交接(Eagle)之前将不同的专家特性重新标注到一个共同的网格.
就视频而言,MERV集合功能在共享的spotemporal网格上,并预测依赖输入的编码器级混合物重量(MERV).
另一种办法是将特征汇总到学到的询问中: BRAVE的MEQ-Former生成一个固定长度的多编码器代表(BRAVE),而Cambrian-1则在二维网格上安排查询,并将每个查询限制在跨编码器(Cambrian1)的空间对应区域.
CoME-VL转而使用SigLIP 2令牌作为DINOv3密钥和值的查询,以导出千变万化的网格,并在每个编码器(CoMEVL)的多层聚合过程中应用正向预测。
LLaVA-Mini专注于符号减少,将基于查询的压缩与图像-文本预化相结合,减少传递给主语言模型的显式视觉符号,同时通过有条件的文本状态(LLaVAMini)传递视觉信息.

blocks.en:
Information present in a representation need not influence the answer; attention weights alone do not establish predictive dependence ( AttentionNotExplanation ) .
To trace visual information flow, CrossModalFlow block image-to-text attention pathways at different depths and measure changes in answer prediction.
At the component level, HalluTrace uses interventions to distinguish visual grounding failure, language-prior dominance, and cross-modal conflict as sources of hallucination ( HalluTrace ) .
These studies examine evidence use through output changes under specified interventions, rather than attention patterns alone.
blocks.zh:
说明中的信息不必影响答案;仅凭注意力权重并不能确定预测依赖性(注意说明)。
为了追踪视觉信息流, CrossModal 不同深度的流程块图像到文本的注意路径,并测量答案预测的变化.
在组件一级,HalluTrace利用干预措施区分视觉定位故障、语言优先优势和跨模式冲突作为幻觉来源(HalluTrace ) 。
这些研究通过特定干预措施下的产出变化来审查证据的使用情况,而不是仅仅审查注意模式。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: PAIQ enriches DINOv3 patch features with SigLIP features in two steps: content-based matching aggregates source features for each patch, and a shared orthogonal transform rotates the difference from the base feature before adding it back. Matching determines what each patch receives; the residual transform determines how that information updates its representation. Figure 3 summarizes the computation and its diagnostic readouts.
blocks.zh: PAIQ在两个步骤中丰富了带有SigLIP特性的DINOv3补丁特性:每个补丁基于内容匹配的集合源特性,一个共享的正交转换在添加回原功能之前从基特征中旋转差异. 匹配决定每个补丁收到什么;剩余变换决定信息如何更新其表达. 图3汇总了计算及其诊断读出。

blocks.en: 3.1 Representations and learning objective
blocks.zh: 3.1 代表性和学习目标

blocks.en: For an image I I , frozen DINOv3 and SigLIP encoders produce n = 196 n=196 and m = 576 m=576 contextualized patch features of dimension 1024 1024 , denoted by 𝑿 d {\bm{X}}_{d} and 𝑿 s {\bm{X}}_{s} . We use the final outputs of both encoders, discarding the CLS and register tokens from DINOv3; preprocessing is specified in Appendix . Independent affine projections map both streams to the language-model dimension d d : 𝑫 = 𝑿 d ​ P d ⊤ + 𝟏 ​ b d ⊤ , 𝑺 = 𝑿 s ​ P s ⊤ + 𝟏 ​ b s ⊤ . {\bm{D}}={\bm{X}}_{d}P_{d}^{\top}+\mathbf{1}b_{d}^{\top},\qquad{\bm{S}}={\bm{X}}_{s}P_{s}^{\top}+\mathbf{1}b_{s}^{\top}. (1) Here P d , P s ∈ ℝ d × 1024 P_{d},P_{s}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times 1024} , with no subsequent activation or normalization. blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate image description on FLUX-Reason ( fang2025fluxreason ) and a CC3M slice (Caption) ( sharma2018conceptual ) , and visual question answering on SEED-Bench ( li2023seedbench ) and A-OKVQA ( schwenk2022aokvqa ) . Matched DINOv3-only, SigLIP-only, and PAIQ models use the same fixed 1,000 records per dataset. Table 4.2 covers Qwen3.5-2B/9B, InternVL3.5-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B language backbones; Table extends Qwen to 27B. FLUX is drawn from the training source and serves as an in-domain description diagnostic; the other datasets assess transfer to different image and question distributions.
blocks.zh: 我们评价FLUX-Reason(fang2025奢侈)和CC3M切片(Caption)(sharma2018概念)上的图像描述,以及SEED-Bench(li2023seedbench)和A-OKVQA(schwenk2022aokvqa)上的视觉问题回答。 匹配的DINov3只,SigLIP只,PAIQ模型每个数据集使用相同的固定1000记录. 表4.2涵盖Wen3.5-2B/9B,InternVL3.5-8B,以及Llama-31-8B语言主干;表将Quen扩展至27B. FLUX来自训练来源,作为域内描述诊断;其他数据集评估转移到不同图像和问题分布.

blocks.en: Following Granulon ( Granulon ) , we use an automatic Judge to score Accuracy and Hallucination independently on [ 0,100 ] [0,100] , with higher Accuracy and lower Hallucination preferred. FLUX and Caption requests contain the image and generated response; SEED and A-OKVQA additionally provide the question, options, and reference answer. These are continuous Judge scores, not official benchmark accuracies. Within each backbone, the matched interfaces share training data and optimization. Table 4.2 also compares Granulon, CoME-VL, MERV, and LLaVA-Mini. Appendix details scoring and validation; Appendix provides VQA prompts and identifies the description-template artifacts.
blocks.zh: 格拉努伦(Granulon)之后,我们使用自动裁判器在[0100][0100]上独立得分精确度和幻觉度,更偏爱高准确度和低迷度. FLUX和Caption请求包含图像和生成的响应;SEED和A-OKVQA另外提供了问题,选项和参考答案. 这些是法官连续得分,而不是官方基准的精确度。 在每个骨干内部,匹配的接口共享培训数据和优化. 表4.2还比较了Granulon、CoME-VL、MERV和LLaVA-Mini。 附录细节评分和验证;附录提供VQA提示,并识别描述-模板文物.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: On both Qwen backbones, PAIQ achieves the highest mean Accuracy on all four datasets, exceeding the strongest competing method by 1.11 to 4.78 score points (Table 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在两个Quen主干线上,PAIQ在所有四个数据集上都实现了最高的平均值精确度,超过最强的相竞方法1.11至4.78分(表4.2).

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison across four language backbones and four tasks. Accuracy ( ↑ \uparrow ) and Hallucination ( ↓ \downarrow ) are mean Judge scores. The DINOv3, SigLIP, and PAIQ comparisons use 1,000 examples per setting. Bold and underlining mark the best and second-best displayed values, respectively, within each backbone and task metric. Colored arrows beside each baseline give the direction and size of PAIQ’s difference from that baseline in score points; green favors PAIQ and red favors the baseline.
blocks.zh: 表1:四个语文主干线和四个任务的比较。 准确度(QQ)和幻觉度(QQ)是评委的评分。 DINOv3,SigLIP和PAIQ比较每设定使用1000例. 粗体和下划线分别标出每个主干和任务指标中的最佳和第二最佳显示值。 每个基线旁的彩色箭头在分数点上给出了PAIQ的方向和大小与基线的区别;绿色偏好PAIQ,红色偏好基线.
